review_notes: Raw str annotation tokens should render without a second quoting layer. Generated-stub AST distinguishes qualified Name/Attribute from Constant. get_type_hints can eventually resolve both, so this is a representation contract, not R1 namespace evidence. Smith patch introduces defect. Reviewed inverse touches only production. All original F2P/P2P and complete file scope retained. Expected diagnostic error is not a policy failure. Explicit copy-mode dependency installation profile avoids external-site path mismatch. Diagnostic checks real pytest.skip code filename is inside sysconfig purelib, and current workspace source hash, before the task observation.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,hashlib
import pytest,sysconfig
purelib=Path(sysconfig.get_path('purelib')).resolve()
pytest_code=Path(pytest.skip.__code__.co_filename).resolve()
print('dependency_binding',pytest.__version__,pytest_code,'sandbox_purelib',purelib)
assert pytest_code.is_relative_to(purelib),(pytest_code,purelib)
import monkeytype.stubs as module
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
assert actual==(Path.cwd()/'monkeytype/stubs.py').resolve(),actual
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Python',sys.version)
import ast
from inspect import Signature,Parameter
from monkeytype.stubs import FunctionStub,FunctionKind
text=FunctionStub('read_value',Signature([Parameter('value',Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,annotation='pkg.Value')]),FunctionKind.MODULE).render()
print('generated_stub',text)
node=ast.parse(text).body[0].args.args[0].annotation
print('annotation_ast',ast.dump(node))
assert isinstance(node,ast.Attribute),ast.dump(node)
assert isinstance(node.value,ast.Name) and node.value.id=='pkg' and node.attr=='Value'
PYREPLAY
